root_cause.text: After commit aab5c6f20023 ("gpio: set device type for GPIO chips") unset `gdev->dev.release`, the error paths in `gpiochip_add_data_with_key()` failed to drop the reference count to `gdev->dev` via `gpio_device_put()`, leading to resource leaks because manual cleanup was used instead of the proper release mechanism.
root_cause.evidence: The patch reorders initialization to call `device_initialize()` early, then replaces all manual error-handling paths (e.g., `kfree_const(gdev->label)`, `kfree(gdev->descs)`, `kfree(dev_name(&gdev->dev))`) with a single `err_put_device:` that calls `gpio_device_put(gdev)`, which invokes `gpiodev_release()` for proper cleanup. The CVE description explicitly states that `gdev->dev.release` was unset, causing the reference count not to be dropped.

The CVE description explicitly states that `gdev->dev.release` was unset, causing the reference count not to be dropped.

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactor gpiochip_setup_dev by moving device_initialize to its caller to centralize device initialization and reference count handling.
intent_record.what: Remove device_initialize() call from gpiochip_setup_dev() and add a comment explaining that an initial reference count is held in gpiochip_add_data_with_key(), so the caller must drop the reference on errors.
intent_record.how: The device initialization (device_initialize) is no longer performed inside gpiochip_setup_dev. Instead, it is expected to have been done earlier (in gpiochip_add_data_with_key), so the function only performs subsequent setup steps. This shifts the responsibility of reference count management to the caller.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a reference leak by calling gpio_device_put when gpiochip_setup_dev fails.
intent_record.what: Added a call to gpio_device_put(gdev) before the error message when gpiochip_setup_dev fails, and added braces for the if block.
intent_record.how: Previously, on failure, only an error was printed without releasing the reference. Now, the reference count is decremented via gpio_device_put, preventing a reference leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing device_initialize, missing pin_ranges list initialization, and cleanup ordering to prevent use of uninitialized resources and memory leaks in GPIO chip registration.
intent_record.what: Reordered and added initialization steps in gpiochip_add_data_with_key: added device_initialize call, moved srcu struct initialization earlier, added INIT_LIST_HEAD for pin_ranges under CONFIG_PINCTRL, consolidated error goto labels to err_put_device, and reordered field assignments.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this ensures that the device is properly initialized via device_initialize before its properties are set, srcu structures are initialized before any code that might use them, the pin_ranges list head is initialized (if CONFIG_PINCTRL), and error paths correctly release resources via gpiodev_release.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix error handling in gpiochip_add_data_with_key to jump to the correct cleanup label when base allocation fails, ensuring proper resource cleanup.
intent_record.what: Changed the error handling goto target from err_cleanup_desc_srcu to err_put_device when base allocation fails in gpiochip_add_data_with_key.
intent_record.how: When base < 0 (indicating failure in base allocation), the error cleanup path now jumps to err_put_device instead of err_cleanup_desc_srcu, altering the sequence of cleanup operations performed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactor gpiochip_add_data_with_key by moving pin_ranges initialization out of the conditional block and adjusting error handling to use a more appropriate cleanup label.
intent_record.what: Removed the conditional initialization of gdev->pin_ranges list head inside #ifdef CONFIG_PINCTRL, and changed the error goto target from err_cleanup_desc_srcu to err_put_device when gpiodev_add_to_list_unlocked fails.
intent_record.how: The pin_ranges list head is no longer initialized in this function (presumably moved elsewhere), and on error, the function now jumps to err_put_device instead of err_cleanup_desc_srcu, altering the cleanup sequence to skip desc_srcu cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential reference leak and simplify error handling by always calling gpio_device_put in gpiochip_add_data_with_key error paths.
intent_record.what: Removed conditional check for gdev->dev.release before gpio_device_put; replaced with unconditional gpio_device_put at a new label err_put_device. Removed error labels err_free_label, err_free_descs, err_free_dev_name and their associated kfree calls.
intent_record.how: The error path now always calls gpio_device_put(gdev) instead of only when gdev->dev.release is set. The manual freeing of gdev->label, gdev->descs, and dev_name(&gdev->dev) is eliminated, relying on gpio_device_put to handle cleanup.
